module autovcoder_074813 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 8
) (
    input alu_clk,
    input [1:0] operation,
    input [WIDTH-1:0] in,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] out,
    output carry_out
);
  reg carry = 0;
  initial begin
    out = 0;
  end

  // do everything at a clock edge to make timing more predictable
  always @(posedge alu_clk) begin
    // if (alu_clk) begin
    case (operation)
      // Zero
      2'b11: begin
        carry <= 0;
        out   <= 0;
      end
      // Shift Right
      2'b10: begin
        carry <= in[0];
        out   <= {carry, in[WIDTH-1:1]};
      end
      // Shift Left
      2'b01: begin
        carry <= in[WIDTH-1];
        out   <= {in[WIDTH-2:0], carry};
      end
      // Pass Through
      default: begin
        carry <= carry;
        out   <= in;
      end
    endcase
    // end else begin
    //     carry_out <= carry_out;
    //     out <= out;
    // end
  end
  assign carry_out = carry;
endmodule
